author: Vince J Kaminski
text:
Rosa,

I am writing to you on behalf of my organization, Northgate Industrial Partners 
(NIP).  We are a specialty industrial air quality consulting firm based in 
southcentral Pennsylvania.  We sell industrial ventilation audits.

The Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) recently 
announced that a new state air permit rule will take effect January 1, 2001.  
The rule requires coating and finishing facilities to comply with a new 
standard for emissions and to submit an extensive permit application.  This 
new rule will drastically increase the time and cost of the permitting 
process.  In addition, this rule has been controversial from the start and 
can be expected to face increased scrutiny.  These factors will likely delay 
the permit process even further.

The purpose of this letter is to provide you with an opportunity to save 
your facility money and time.  One way to do this is by conducting an 
industrial ventilation audit.  These audits are conducted on site in one day 
and are followed by a written report within two weeks.  Our engineers have 
more than ten years of experience in finishing shops and are particularly 
skilled in the application of the ACGIH TLVs and OSHA PELs.  I would like to 
make this offer to your company.  Please give me a quick call or send a short 
note with the right contact.

Regards,

Greg Goudis
Territory Sales Manager
Northgate Industrial Partners
814-361-5200
